title: AAC Operation Interaction Reliable Exchange 1
description: Transport exchange: monotonic cumulative P2C acknowledgment, optional C2P snapshot, and ordered list of all unacknowledged P2C publications. No application-level ACK or request/reply handshake.

AcknowledgedProviderRevision.description: Highest contiguous P2C publication fully processed by caller; supplied by caller in next exchange.

Messages.description: Zero or more ordered unacknowledged P2C messages, including optional direct response.
